final_message:
I parsed the log file `workspace/worker.log` by iterating through each entry, extracting the timestamp, UTC offset, service, level, and message (text after the last ` | ` separator on the first line). Multi-line payloads were handled by skipping indented lines following the entry, and `repeat_count` was computed as 1 plus any repeated message counts specified on subsequent lines. Entries with levels in `ERROR`, `SEVERE`, or `FATAL` (case-insensitive) were filtered, converted to UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`, normalized to uppercase levels, and summarized into `workspace/errors.json` along with aggregate `counts_by_service`.

Summary of created/changed files:
- `workspace/errors.json`
